reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the user-provided parameter 'bar' which is concatenated into the HTML response via 'encodeForHTML(...)' but the XSS vulnerability arises because the user input flows into the SQL string and then gets echoed back in the HTML response without sufficient sanitization.
